30fps.scope_limit: Prepared test clip has 25 source FPS. Output metadata set to30 or duplicate/interpolated frames would not demonstrate 30 distinct causal processed camera frames/sec.

optimization_candidates.candidate: Instrument INSwapper crop, cached source latent, model_call, output decode, paste-back warp, morphology and blend separately
optimization_candidates.evidence: 77.336 ms warm mean outside model_run within swap; current wrapper lumps all of get(paste_back=True).

optimization_candidates.candidate: Cache projected and normalized fixed source latent; avoid redundant target face embedding; use detection/keypoints directly with face identity lock
optimization_candidates.evidence: Exact package uses only source_face.normed_embedding for INSwapper latent, and FaceAnalysis.get runs all retained models on every target face.
optimization_candidates.status: Proposed; exact numerical equivalence and identity-reacquisition behavior require verification

optimization_candidates.candidate: Single ROI paste-back/composite from original current frame; eliminate unused fake_diff work only after equivalence checks
optimization_candidates.evidence: Upstream paste_back contains full-frame warps/morphology/float blend; subsequent adapter composites cropped result again. Existing combine initializes result=swapped_bgr.copy so pixels outside crop can retain first paste-back.
optimization_candidates.status: Proposed; not a measured individual-operation saving

optimization_candidates.candidate: Keep debug quality/comparison exporters off the live frame path; asynchronous bounded latest-frame capture/output preserving timestamps and sequence
optimization_candidates.evidence: Full quality54.795ms and two-output stage9.072ms are offline costs. Decode1.151ms and backend177.394ms remain.
optimization_candidates.status: Proposed; no live camera latency/drop measurement yet

optimization_candidates.candidate: Separate quality and real-time profiles; optimize/replace per-frame restoration and occlusion only after hand/mouth/eye quality tests
optimization_candidates.evidence: Warm serial remaining model calls68.048ms excluding targetrecognition already exceed33.333ms.
optimization_candidates.status: Proposed; TensorRT/FP16/IObinding/device ROI must be benchmarked on pinned models; temporal mask refresh may worsen fast-hand occlusions

temporal_findings.implemented: Fixed source identity and monotonic timestamp validation only. No landmark/pose/mask/color temporal filter in frozen baseline.
likely_jitter_sources_to_measure: Integer bbox and 18% padding change XSeg/GFPGAN crop coordinate systems
GFPGAN frame-independent high-blend restoration can fluctuate invented texture/details
Fresh XSeg masks and fixed13px blur can produce boundary shimmer
Largest-face selection can switch identity if multiple people appear
candidate_controls: Tracked identity lock with gated reacquisition
Timestamp-aware velocity-sensitive landmark/alignment filtering; reset on scene cut/large gaps
Flow-warp previous mask with current-frame validation and conservative rejection of hand-edge smear
Stable aligned face ROI for restoration and occlusion
Low-rate filtered color/exposure parameters and confidence-based restore blending
temporal_findings.caveat: These are source-based hypotheses and proposed controls, not measured jitter attribution or implemented fixes.

limitations: Full baseline has no ORT node profiles; model_run numbers come from the different30frame profiled probe. Do not directly subtract probe ORT timing from full-video stage timing.
No device Kernel events exist, so provider-labeled Node event counts prove assignment/execution evidence but their durations or sum do not represent pure GPU kernel time.
Session/model_run is the full synchronous ORT run event, including relevant runtime/transfer/synchronization work; it is not neural FLOPs alone.
First model calls and source prepare warm-up are disclosed; excluding one processed frame is a small29frame exploratory sample rather than productionsteady-state validation.
Stage means include fallback zeros across full baseline; full complete3076frame benchmark should be the deployment reference.
NVMLdevicepeak4408.5MiB includes all device processes, process allocation was unavailable; extra VRAM and an RTX3090 are not proven quality improvements.
No human visual review or new camera test was performed in this read-only performance audit.
